market.conclusion: Tech (QQQ) is in a downtrend and the broad market (SPY) is moving sideways. Breadth is weak, with 27% of stocks above their 50-day average. Fear is normal, yields are falling and credit is steady, so this looks like a tech pullback, not broad stress: be selective, and build long-term positions slowly.
arguments: Macro is against every name: QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages and has lagged SPY by 3.1 points over 20 sessions. I weigh this heavily for swing calls in tech.
Technical: most charts are ranges or downtrends. AAPL is the clearest exception. Breadth of 27 backs the caution. I weigh this heavily.
Fundamental: NVDA, ORCL and NFLX are good businesses priced below fair value. This drives the long-term verdicts, not swing timing.
Risk: there are no vetoes. The NVDA report on 2026-11-17 is the one binding date.
Quant: no validated signal, with 0 of 281 forecasts scored, so I give it no weight.

Offsets: the 10-year yield fell from 5.21 to 4.98 in 4 weeks, credit spreads are steady at 3.2, and the VIX is 18.7 (normal). Leadership is in XLV, XLY and XLF, not XLK. These keep me from calling a broad sell-off.
market.change_mind: A QQQ close above $693.76 would end the tech-downtrend case. A SPY close below $745.75 would spread the worry to the broad market.

deep_dive.case_for: It's a grade A business. Revenue grew 83.38% over 12 months and 105.85% in the latest quarter. At $162.85 it is below its whole value range ($195.92–$411.04) and near the bottom of its own 5-year price-to-sales history (8.93 percentile). RSI at 24.9 is oversold.
deep_dive.case_against: It fell 23.95% in 20 days and is in a clear downtrend, with no support level listed. Operating margin of 65% is at the top of its 5-year range. Unpaid customer bills grew faster than sales (127% vs 106%). Insiders sold $946.6M outside pre-set plans. The listed headlines report Jensen Huang's departure.
deep_dive.decides: The 2026-11-17 report (the date is an estimate), and whether it supports growth and margins after the leadership change. Until then, Wait. After it, a close above $169.14 would be the first sign of strength.
